actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident gave >30 units in the last round, and my wallet (1.67) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I must rest and broadcast the discouraging reminder.

Since wallet not above, cannot. Then "If you cannot contribute the minimum amount, rest." So action: rest. Also broadcast short discouraging message. So actions: rest and broadcast with message e.g., "Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low". Explanation accordingly.
